## Linux system libraries

The Linux package (`.deb`) does not contain third-party libraries. GTK,
WebKitGTK and their dependencies are installed by the system package manager
under their own licenses.

## Downloaded on request

The following components are not part of Kimai Tracker. They are downloaded
from their publishers only when you choose to, and are used under the
publisher's license, which you accept with the download:
